newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends up vs dlr,steady vs NBH basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends up vs dlr,steady vs NBH basket.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed steady against the central bank's dollar/mark currency basket and finished a shade firmer against the dollar in routine trade on Friday, dealers said.
The forint closed at 197.18/23 to the dollar, compared to 197.22/32 at opening.
The Hungarian unit remained pinned to the central bank's resistance level throughout the session.
The forint floats within the National Bank of Hungary's 4.5 percent intervention range against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
